```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)

visits  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "visits.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
schools <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
full_updates <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "full_updates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
surveys_raw  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "surveys.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Date range defaults: current school year (Aug 1 – Jul 31)
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
date_min <- school_year_start
date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())

# All school names for the "0 visits" inclusion
all_school_names <- sort(schools$school_name)

# Build JSON for interactive filtering
visits_json_data <- visits |>
  transmute(
    visit_date = as.character(visit_date),
    school_name,
    visitor,
    visit_reason,
    activities
  )

# Full updates: just school_name + update_date for tracking
full_updates_json_data <- full_updates |>
  transmute(
    update_date = as.character(update_date),
    school_name
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(school_name), !is.na(update_date))

# Surveys: school_name + date for tracking
surveys_json_data <- surveys_raw |>
  transmute(
    survey_date = as.character(as.Date(coalesce(
      mdy_hms(StartDate), ymd_hms(StartDate)
    ))),
    school_name
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(school_name), !is.na(survey_date))

visits_json <- toJSON(visits_json_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
schools_json <- toJSON(all_school_names, auto_unbox = TRUE)
full_updates_json <- toJSON(full_updates_json_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
surveys_json <- toJSON(surveys_json_data, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
n_total_schools <- length(all_school_names)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Date range selector + school filter
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  '<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1.5rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center;">',
  '<label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy); font-size:0.9rem;">Date Range:</label>',
  '<input type="date" id="date-start" value="', date_min, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">',
  '<span style="color:#999;">to</span>',
  '<input type="date" id="date-end" value="', date_max, '" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem;">',
  '<select id="school-filter" style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.85rem; max-width:200px;">',
  '<option value="">All Schools</option>',
  '</select>',
  '<button id="btn-apply-dates" style="background:var(--epi-navy); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:0.4rem 1rem; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">Apply</button>',
  '<button id="btn-reset-dates" style="background:#e9ecef; color:#333; border:none; border-radius:4px; padding:0.4rem 1rem; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer;">Reset</button>',
  '</div>'
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Pie chart + needs sections + visit log + visits by school
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
'<!-- Schools That Still Need A Full Update -->
<h2>Schools That Still Need A Full Update</h2>
<p style="color:#666; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:0.75rem;">Schools that have not received a full school update during the current date range.</p>
<div id="needs-update-container" style="margin-bottom:2rem;">
  <table id="needs-survey-table" class="display compact stripe" style="width:100%;"></table>
</div>

<h2>Visit Log</h2>
<div id="visit-log-container" style="margin-bottom:2rem;">
  <table id="visit-log-table" class="display compact stripe" style="width:100%;"></table>
</div>

<h2>Visits by School</h2>
<div id="visits-by-school-container">
  <table id="visits-by-school-table" class="display compact stripe" style="width:100%;"></table>
</div>

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/css/jquery.dataTables.min.css">
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.6/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
<script>
var VISITS = ', visits_json, ';
var ALL_SCHOOLS = ', schools_json, ';
var FULL_UPDATES = ', full_updates_json, ';
var SURVEYS = ', surveys_json, ';
var N_TOTAL = ', n_total_schools, ';
var logDT = null;
var bySchoolDT = null;
var needsDT = null;

function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

// Populate school filter dropdown with notification icons
function populateSchoolFilter() {
  var select = document.getElementById("school-filter");
  var start = document.getElementById("date-start").value;
  var end = document.getElementById("date-end").value;

  // Determine which schools need full updates / surveys in this range
  var schoolsWithFullUpdate = {};
  FULL_UPDATES.forEach(function(u) {
    if (inRange(u.update_date, start, end)) schoolsWithFullUpdate[u.school_name] = true;
  });
  var schoolsWithSurveys = {};
  SURVEYS.forEach(function(s) {
    if (inRange(s.survey_date, start, end)) schoolsWithSurveys[s.school_name] = true;
  });

  // Preserve current selection
  var currentVal = select.value;
  select.innerHTML = \'<option value="">All Schools</option>\';
  ALL_SCHOOLS.forEach(function(name) {
    var opt = document.createElement("option");
    var needsUpdate = !schoolsWithFullUpdate[name];
    var needsSurvey = !schoolsWithSurveys[name];
    var icon = (needsUpdate || needsSurvey) ? "\u26A0\uFE0F " : "";
    opt.value = name;
    opt.textContent = icon + name;
    select.appendChild(opt);
  });
  select.value = currentVal;
}

function renderVisitPage() {
  var start = document.getElementById("date-start").value;
  var end   = document.getElementById("date-end").value;
  var schoolFilter = document.getElementById("school-filter").value;

  populateSchoolFilter();

  var filtered = VISITS.filter(function(v) {
    if (!inRange(v.visit_date, start, end)) return false;
    if (schoolFilter && v.school_name !== schoolFilter) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // --- Schools Needing Full Updates ---
  var schoolsWithFullUpdate = {};
  FULL_UPDATES.forEach(function(u) {
    if (inRange(u.update_date, start, end)) schoolsWithFullUpdate[u.school_name] = true;
  });
  var schoolsWithSurveys = {};
  SURVEYS.forEach(function(s) {
    if (inRange(s.survey_date, start, end)) schoolsWithSurveys[s.school_name] = true;
  });

  var needsUpdate = ALL_SCHOOLS.filter(function(name) {
    return !schoolsWithFullUpdate[name];
  });

  // Build needs-update table: schools that still need a full update
  if (needsDT) { needsDT.destroy(); document.getElementById("needs-survey-table").innerHTML = ""; }

  if (needsUpdate.length === 0) {
    document.getElementById("needs-update-container").innerHTML = \'<div style="background:#d4edda; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.5rem; border-left:4px solid #28a745;"><p style="margin:0; color:#155724; font-weight:600;">All schools have received a full update!</p></div>\';
  } else {
    var needsData = needsUpdate.sort().map(function(name) {
      return [name];
    });

    needsDT = jQuery("#needs-survey-table").DataTable({
      data: needsData,
      columns: [
        { title: "School" }
      ],
      pageLength: 15,
      order: [[0, "asc"]],
      dom: "lfrtip",
      language: { search: "Search:" }
    });
  }

  // --- Visit Log DataTable ---
  if (logDT) { logDT.destroy(); document.getElementById("visit-log-table").innerHTML = ""; }
  var logData = filtered.map(function(v) {
    return [v.visit_date || "", v.school_name || "", v.visitor || "", v.visit_reason || "", v.activities || ""];
  });
  logDT = jQuery("#visit-log-table").DataTable({
    data: logData,
    columns: [
      { title: "Date", width: "100px" },
      { title: "School", width: "140px" },
      { title: "Staff Member", width: "100px" },
      { title: "Visit Reason" },
      { title: "Activities" }
    ],
    pageLength: 15,
    order: [[0, "desc"]],
    dom: "lfrtip",
    autoWidth: false
  });

  // --- Visits by School (include 0-visit schools) ---
  if (bySchoolDT) { bySchoolDT.destroy(); document.getElementById("visits-by-school-table").innerHTML = ""; }
  var schoolCounts = {};
  ALL_SCHOOLS.forEach(function(s) { schoolCounts[s] = 0; });
  filtered.forEach(function(v) { if (v.school_name && schoolCounts.hasOwnProperty(v.school_name)) schoolCounts[v.school_name]++; });

  var schoolList = schoolFilter ? [schoolFilter] : Object.keys(schoolCounts).sort();
  var bySchoolData = schoolList.map(function(s) {
    return [s, schoolCounts[s] || 0];
  });

  bySchoolDT = jQuery("#visits-by-school-table").DataTable({
    data: bySchoolData,
    columns: [
      { title: "School" },
      { title: "Visits", width: "80px" }
    ],
    pageLength: 15,
    order: [[1, "desc"]],
    dom: "lfrtip"
  });
}

// Initial render + event listeners
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Check URL parameter for school filter (e.g., ?school=Adenya)
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var schoolParam = params.get("school");
  if (schoolParam) {
    var decoded = decodeURIComponent(schoolParam);
    var select = document.getElementById("school-filter");
    // Need to populate options first, then set value
    populateSchoolFilter();
    select.value = decoded;
  }

  renderVisitPage();
  document.getElementById("btn-apply-dates").addEventListener("click", renderVisitPage);
  document.getElementById("school-filter").addEventListener("change", renderVisitPage);
  document.getElementById("btn-reset-dates").addEventListener("click", function() {
    var now = new Date();
    var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
    document.getElementById("date-start").value = syYear + "-08-01";
    document.getElementById("date-end").value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    document.getElementById("school-filter").value = "";
    renderVisitPage();
  });
});
</script>
'))
```
